scripts.build: npm run guide && vite build && node scripts/dotnet.mjs build backend/dotnet/Onboarding.Api.csproj
scripts.test: node scripts/frontend-tests.mjs && node scripts/dotnet.mjs test backend/tests/Onboarding.Tests.csproj
scripts.format: prettier --write "frontend/*.ts" "frontend/*.tsx" "frontend/components/*.tsx" "scripts/*.mjs" vite.config.ts && node scripts/dotnet.mjs format Onboarding.sln whitespace
scripts.format:check: prettier --check "frontend/*.ts" "frontend/*.tsx" "frontend/components/*.tsx" "scripts/*.mjs" vite.config.ts && node scripts/dotnet.mjs format Onboarding.sln whitespace --verify-no-changes
